scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: In movies, the needle jumps, and the liar is caught. But does a lie detector really detect lies?

scenes.name: sensors
scenes.text: A polygraph records three things. Your blood pressure and pulse, your breathing, and how much your skin sweats.

scenes.name: questions
scenes.text: The examiner mixes neutral questions, control questions, and the real questions about the case.

scenes.name: compare
scenes.text: If your body reacts more strongly to the real questions, that's read as a sign of deception.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: But it measures stress, not lies. A nervous innocent person can fail, and a calm liar can pass.

scenes.name: science
scenes.text: Major scientific reviews found it far from reliable, which is why many courts won't accept it as proof.

scenes.name: india
scenes.text: In India, the Supreme Court ruled that it can't be forced on anyone. It needs consent.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Pulse, breath, sweat, stress. Not a lie meter. Follow for more on how things really work.
